plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing S&C build with one focused full-body session each week. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lift so later percentage work is anchored correctly, and the main training starts in Week 2. With only one weekly session and a preference for more conditioning, the day is kept efficient: explosive work first, then main strength, then practical accessories, then short fight-useful conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body strength and simple full-body power while keeping conditioning supportive and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with slightly heavier work while trimming anything that adds fatigue without clear return.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it faster with sharper power and speed-oriented work.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height you can land on quietly and confidently. Reset between reps and stop if jump height or landing quality drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if boxes are busy or setup is awkward. Jump tall, land softly, and reset each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want an even simpler jump option. Start from a still position and drive straight up.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up in small jumps until the weight feels hard but still clean. Brace hard, stay balanced through the whole foot, and finish with a technically solid heavy set.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. This establishes your baseline for future percentage-based work.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if shoulder position or bar comfort is limiting. Keep the same hard top set of 3-5 clean reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if barbell squatting is not yet safe or coachable. Take the heaviest clean set of 5 with strong posture.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Use a steady squeeze at the top and keep your chest glued to the pad. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the bench station is taken. Keep the torso stable and pull the elbow back without twisting.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a simple machine option. Keep the ribcage down and pause briefly at the body.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Control the lowering, touch the same spot each rep, and press hard without bouncing. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you are comfortable with the barbell. Keep shoulder blades set and press with control.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a simpler bodyweight option. Stop before body line or range breaks down.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Keep ribs down and glutes lightly on. Only roll as far as you can without losing the trunk position.

substitutionOptions.name: Stability Ball Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the ab wheel is too difficult. Keep the same trunk control and range standards.

substitutionOptions.name: Cable Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you need a simpler trunk option. Move through the trunk, not the hips.

exercises.name: Air Bike Intervals
exercises.notes: Push hard but stay smooth. This is conditioning, not a leg-destroying finisher.

endurancePrescription.intensity: Hard efforts around 8/10 with full control of breathing by the next round
